name: Total population
methodology: Total enumerated population per the decadal Census of India; intercensal years use official projections where published.

name: Sex ratio
methodology: Number of females per 1,000 males in the enumerated population, per the Census of India.

name: Urban population share
methodology: Share of population living in areas classified urban by the Census of India.

name: Literacy rate
methodology: Share of persons aged 7 and above able to read and write with understanding, per Census of India / NSO literacy surveys.

name: Gross enrolment ratio (secondary)
methodology: Enrolment at the NEP 2020 Secondary stage (Classes IX to XII) as a share of the corresponding age-group population, total of boys and girls, per UDISE+ (Ministry of Education).

name: Pupil-teacher ratio (elementary)
methodology: Enrolled pupils per teacher at the elementary stage, per UDISE+.

name: Gross State Domestic Product
methodology: GSDP at current prices as published by MoSPI / state economic surveys. Base-year revisions break comparability across series; note the base year.

name: Per capita income
methodology: Per capita Net State Domestic Product at current prices, per MoSPI.

name: Fiscal deficit
methodology: Gross fiscal deficit as a share of GSDP, per RBI's annual State Finances: A Study of Budgets.

name: Unemployment rate
methodology: Unemployment rate (usual status) for persons aged 15+, per the Periodic Labour Force Survey (NSO).

name: Infant mortality rate
methodology: Infant deaths per 1,000 live births, per the Sample Registration System (Registrar General of India).

name: Life expectancy at birth
methodology: Expectation of life at birth, per SRS abridged life tables.

name: Government hospital beds
methodology: Beds in government hospitals per lakh population, per the National Health Profile (CBHI).

name: Household toilet coverage
methodology: Share of households with access to a toilet facility, per Census of India / NFHS / Swachh Bharat Mission reporting; sources differ in definition, note which.

name: Household electrification
methodology: Share of households using electricity as primary lighting source, per Census of India / Saubhagya dashboard.

name: Total road length
methodology: Total road length maintained by all agencies, per Basic Road Statistics of India (MoRTH).

name: Internet subscribers
methodology: Internet subscribers per 100 population, per TRAI performance indicator reports (licensed service area mapped to state).

name: Foodgrain production
methodology: Total foodgrain production, per Agricultural Statistics at a Glance (Ministry of Agriculture).

name: Irrigated area
methodology: Net irrigated area as a share of net sown area, per Land Use Statistics (Ministry of Agriculture).

name: Annual rainfall
methodology: Actual annual rainfall for the meteorological subdivision, per the India Meteorological Department.

name: Forest cover
methodology: Forest cover as a share of geographical area, per the biennial India State of Forest Report (Forest Survey of India).

name: Protected areas
methodology: Number of national parks and wildlife sanctuaries, per the Wildlife Institute of India / ENVIS.

name: Cognizable crime rate
methodology: Cognizable IPC crimes registered per lakh population, per NCRB Crime in India. Registration rates vary by state; higher figures can reflect better registration.

name: Crimes against women
methodology: Crimes against women registered per lakh female population, per NCRB Crime in India; the registration caveat applies.

name: Road accident deaths
methodology: Persons killed in road accidents, per MoRTH Road Accidents in India.

name: Total fertility rate
methodology: Average number of children expected to be born per woman over her reproductive span at current age-specific fertility rates, per SRS Statistical Reports (Registrar General of India).

name: Unemployment rate (rural)
methodology: Unemployed per 1,000 persons in the rural labour force, usual status (adjusted), per NSSO Employment-Unemployment Surveys and PLFS. The survey changed to PLFS from 2017-18; earlier and later figures are not strictly comparable.

name: Unemployment rate (urban)
methodology: Unemployed per 1,000 persons in the urban labour force, usual status (adjusted), per NSSO Employment-Unemployment Surveys and PLFS. The survey changed to PLFS from 2017-18; earlier and later figures are not strictly comparable.

name: Steel capacity, operating
methodology: Sum of current capacity over Indian steelmaking furnace units with status operating or operating pre-retirement, across electric arc, basic oxygen, induction and open hearth routes. Snapshot at the named release, not a historical series: the tracker records each unit's current capacity, and start years are unknown for most Indian units, so no year-by-year reconstruction is published. The tracker covers only plants of 0.5 million tonnes per annum and greater, so small plants are outside these totals. Source: Global Energy Monitor, Global Iron and Steel Tracker, June 2026 (V1) release, CC BY 4.0.

name: Steel capacity, under construction
methodology: Sum of current capacity over Indian steelmaking furnace units with status construction. Snapshot at the named release, not a historical series: the tracker records each unit's current capacity, and start years are unknown for most Indian units, so no year-by-year reconstruction is published. The tracker covers only plants of 0.5 million tonnes per annum and greater, so small plants are outside these totals. Source: Global Energy Monitor, Global Iron and Steel Tracker, June 2026 (V1) release, CC BY 4.0.

methodology: Sum of current capacity over Indian steelmaking furnace units with status announced. Announced projects may never be built. Snapshot at the named release, not a historical series: the tracker records each unit's current capacity, and start years are unknown for most Indian units, so no year-by-year reconstruction is published. The tracker covers only plants of 0.5 million tonnes per annum and greater, so small plants are outside these totals. Source: Global Energy Monitor, Global Iron and Steel Tracker, June 2026 (V1) release, CC BY 4.0.

name: Steel capacity, operating, electric arc route
methodology: Sum of current capacity over Indian electric arc furnace units with status operating or operating pre-retirement. Source: Global Energy Monitor, Global Iron and Steel Tracker, June 2026 (V1) release, CC BY 4.0.

name: Steel capacity, operating, basic oxygen route
methodology: Sum of current capacity over Indian basic oxygen furnace units with status operating or operating pre-retirement. Snapshot at the named release, not a historical series: the tracker records each unit's current capacity, and start years are unknown for most Indian units, so no year-by-year reconstruction is published. name: Steel capacity, operating, induction route
methodology: Sum of current capacity over Indian induction furnace units with status operating or operating pre-retirement. Snapshot at the named release, not a historical series: the tracker records each unit's current capacity, and start years are unknown for most Indian units, so no year-by-year reconstruction is published. name: Steel capacity, nominal crude, operating plants
methodology: Sum of nominal crude steel capacity over GEM-tracked Indian plants with status operating or operating pre-retirement, attributed to the state of the plant. Plant-level nominal capacity; the archive's unit-level steel indicators sum individual tracked furnaces instead, so the two measures differ and neither is adjusted toward the other. The tracker covers only plants of 0.5 million tonnes per annum and greater. Snapshot at the named release. Source: Global Energy Monitor, Global Iron and Steel Tracker, June 2026 (V1) release, CC BY 4.0.

name: Cement capacity, operating
methodology: Sum of cement capacity over GEM-tracked Indian cement plants with status operating, attributed to the state of the plant, per the tracker's own inclusion criteria. Snapshot at the named release, not a historical series. Source: Global Energy Monitor, Global Cement and Concrete Tracker, July 2026 (V1) release, CC BY 4.0.

name: Metallurgical coal mined
methodology: Country-level metallurgical coal production, estimated by GEM by summing mine-level production, using mine capacity where production is unknown. The file's consumption columns are factor-based estimates and are not published here. Snapshot for the release period. Source: Global Energy Monitor, Production and Consumption of Met Coal and Iron Ore by Steel Industry, December 2025 (V1) release, CC BY 4.0.

name: Iron ore mined
methodology: Country-level iron ore production, estimated by GEM by summing mine-level production, applying a 45 percent utilization rate to capacity where production is unknown. The file's consumption columns are factor-based estimates and are not published here. Snapshot for the release period. Source: Global Energy Monitor, Production and Consumption of Met Coal and Iron Ore by Steel Industry, December 2025 (V1) release, CC BY 4.0.

name: Pig iron produced
methodology: Country-level pig iron production as reported by the World Steel Association, with GEM blast furnace capacity used where WSA production is unknown. The file's consumption columns are factor-based estimates and are not published here. Snapshot for the release period. Source: Global Energy Monitor, Production and Consumption of Met Coal and Iron Ore by Steel Industry, December 2025 (V1) release, CC BY 4.0.

name: Direct reduced iron produced
methodology: Country-level DRI production as reported by the World Steel Association, with GEM DRI capacity used where WSA production is unknown. The file's consumption columns are factor-based estimates and are not published here. Snapshot for the release period. Source: Global Energy Monitor, Production and Consumption of Met Coal and Iron Ore by Steel Industry, December 2025 (V1) release, CC BY 4.0.
